text: Security is a crucial part of web development. When building a website, developers must protect both user data and the system itself. One basic step is using HTTPS, which encrypts information sent between the browser and the server. Another important practice is authentication, which makes sure only the right users can access protected areas. Developers should also validate all input, because unchecked data can open the door to attacks. Common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, are often caused by weak input handling. By following these practices, developers can reduce risks and create safer websites for everyone.
